title.narrative: Improved labour market statistics for evidence-based employment promotion

description.narrative: Labour market information systems (LMIS) inform the design, implementation, monitoring and evaluation of humanitarian livelihood programmes and projects that are better focused and targeted. Labour force survey (LFS) is the key source of labour market data that contributes to the functioning of LMIS when it becomes available. LFS can be designed to cover the entire population, all sectors, and all categories of workers, including own-account workers, contributing family workers and persons engaged in casual work or marginal economic activity. ILO will support statistical offices to upgrade LFS with the establishment of LMIS in the long-term horizon. Such support will cater to different intersectional vulnerabilities and the needs of the various groups at risk including IDPs, people with disabilities, children, women, youth and informal workers and economic units, among others.
